sentences.text: The so-called Gutka has been seized from the spot of the incident itself.
In view of these facts, the applicant has a good case for interim protection.

Hence, the following order :-
In the event of arrest, applicant Sayyad Jamir s/o. Sayyed Isak, be released on interim bail, on furnishing PB and SB of Rs.20,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount, in C.R.No.0377 of 2022 registered with Basmath Police Station, District Hingoli, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
